major_work.finding: The latest current news contains PRIMARY Bank of Korea items, but the persisted 80-issue view contains no official_source_available issue and neither primary article is traceable in issue.articles. Because issue_doc truncates the ranked merged issue set to 80 after importance/state ranking, primary evidence can be collected successfully yet disappear from the issue layer used for top issues and AI linkage.
major_work.interpretation: This does not prove the official releases are market-important. It proves source quality is not guaranteed visibility/traceability in the persisted issue layer. A PRIMARY item should not be promoted merely because it is official, but it should remain provenance-addressable and eligible for explicit relevance scoring rather than silently falling outside the truncated issue set.
unknown: Whether the primary clusters ranked below 80 solely because of relevance score, state rank, or fragmentation requires full untruncated cluster instrumentation.
Historical frequency of primary-source visibility loss is not measured.

handoff.task: Separate provenance retention from importance ranking: preserve all article→event lineage and maintain a primary-source evidence index even when an event is outside top-N display.
Measure primary-source drop rate before/after top-N truncation and test whether source-quality bonus distorts relevance ranking.
Add regression/observability: primary_items_count > 0 with zero traceable primary issue lineage must be explicit, not silently reported as healthy issue intelligence.

next_work: Audit whether issue state rank dominates importance score enough to keep low-relevance NEW fragments above higher-quality PERSISTING evidence.
